text.card: A red giant 2,596 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.88 solar masses and 5.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,099 K at its surface.
